title: Sample a raster at points or over areas

ontology.note: Three readings, one widget (experiment 205). At points, from a raster: fw:RasterPointSample, as 0.2.0. Over areas, from a raster: fw:RasterAreaTotal, with the cell rule, the areas, the cells totalled, the cells with no data, the cells beyond the window and the areas with no total. From satellite files: fw:SatellitePointSample and fw:SatelliteAreaSample, as Sample satellite files 0.7.0 declared them. The output follows the input: points, polygons or a table. 0.4.0: fw:cellStatisticsGiven, stated when the mean, minimum and maximum of the cells are given.

changes.description: Over areas, the cells of each area are found by scanline, row by row from where its outline crosses the row's centre line, by the same cell-centre rule; it tested every cell of the area's box against every vertex, and Botswana's 10 districts over WorldPop 2025 (123 million cells) did not finish in ten minutes. Now 6.3 s. The totals name what they are, column and unit, for the map's key.

evidence.note: Seven unit checks cover the containing-cell value, no-data and masked cells, points outside the grid, points without coordinates, the half-open cell edges, a refused existing attribute, refused attribute names and a refused CRS. A cell value is not a measurement at the point and no interpolation is claimed. Agreement with an external point sampler is not established; see docs/experiments/67-sample-raster-at-points.md. Composition is established by tests/composition-elevation.test.mjs, a minimal fixture wiring Area around a point to Clip raster to Sample raster at points with synthetic data. The sea-level worked example remains the teaching artifact and does not gate this release; see the protective/maturity distinction in docs/audits/ontology-audit.md. 0.2.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks bilinear against hand arithmetic, a missing neighbour and an edge point. 0.3.0: tests/raster-areas.test.mjs checks totals on a 4x4 grid against hand counts, a no-data cell, an area half outside the window, an area with no cell, the output by source, and a saved satellite sampler migrated. Agreement with an external zonal sum is not yet established. 0.4.0: tests/raster-areas.test.mjs checks the minimum and maximum against hand counts, the mean of three cells, an area with no value giving none, and the statistics absent unless asked. 0.4.1: tests/sample-raster-areas.browser.mjs reads the five named ports and the output on the canvas; Chromium. 0.5.0: tests/sample-raster-arrivals.browser.mjs (the raster named, units filled as the source record states, nothing connected said, Read it over the square, 968 people over 16 cells; the Inspector's input names equal the node's); Chromium. 0.5.1: tests/raster-areas-scanline.test.mjs (the predicate's cells, cell for cell, over 25 random outlines with holes and parts; the totals' name); Botswana by hand against rasterio, every district's total and cell count equal; Chromium.
